retention_profiles.D1: Usually low-risk factual/procedural routine; spaced checks, with annual refresh considered only after strong delayed performance.
retention_profiles.D2: Conceptual or practical procedure with moderate decay; periodic retrieval and varied-context demonstration.
retention_profiles.D3: Coordination, communication or performance ability; more frequent practice is commonly needed to preserve fluency.
retention_profiles.D4: Safety-critical or emergency capability; current certified instruction and practical refresh required; annual solo review is not a substitute.

records.name: Close a work session cleanly

records.name: Doomsday Algorithm (weekday mental calculation)
records.target_performance: Calculate the weekday for a Gregorian calendar date using a taught algorithm, explain leap-year handling and verify edge cases.
records.assessment: Given 20 dates across ordinary years, leap years and century boundaries, calculate at least 18 correctly and explain the method.
records.maintenance_note: Set review timing from delayed performance and real-world use; annual-only practice is not assumed sufficient.
records.safety_notes: Use published calendar checks during learning; distinguish Gregorian rules from other calendar systems.

records.name: Visual Observation (structured scene description)
records.target_performance: Describe observable scene details systematically while separating direct observation from inference; do not claim reliable personality or threat profiling from appearance.
records.assessment: Describe a neutral image or scene with accurate spatial, clothing/object and change details; label uncertainty and avoid unsupported conclusions.
records.maintenance_note: Set review timing from delayed performance and real-world use; annual-only practice is not assumed sufficient.
records.safety_notes: Privacy-respecting observation only; no stalking, covert tracking, sensitive-trait inference or profiling people.

records.name: Memory Palace (method of loci)
records.target_performance: Encode an ordered set of information using familiar locations and retrieve it in sequence with low error.
records.assessment: Recall a self-created 15–20 item sequence after a delay, then explain where interference or confusion occurred.
records.maintenance_note: Set review timing from delayed performance and real-world use; annual-only practice is not assumed sufficient.
records.safety_notes: Use as a memory aid, not as proof that vivid memories are accurate eyewitness records.

records.name: Lucid-Dream Reality Checks (sleep-safe awareness practice)
records.target_performance: Understand reality-testing as a reflective habit and record dream recall without disrupting sleep or treating checks as guaranteed lucid-dream induction.
records.assessment: Maintain a brief, non-disruptive dream-recall log and describe the limits of reality checks; no required sleep interruption.
records.maintenance_note: Set review timing from delayed performance and real-world use; annual-only practice is not assumed sufficient.
records.safety_notes: Protect sleep duration and quality; stop if it causes anxiety, sleep disruption, derealisation or distress. Not a treatment.

records.name: Speed Reading (flexible reading-rate control)
records.target_performance: Adjust reading pace to purpose while preserving comprehension; slow down for dense, technical or unfamiliar material.
records.assessment: Compare baseline and trained reading on equivalent passages; report rate and comprehension separately, with comprehension meeting a pre-set threshold.
records.maintenance_note: Set review timing from delayed performance and real-world use; annual-only practice is not assumed sufficient.
records.safety_notes: No universal speed target; reject techniques that increase words per minute while destroying understanding.

records.name: Morse Code (basic send and receive)
records.target_performance: Recognise and send a defined set of Morse letters/numbers with accurate timing and spacing.
records.assessment: Transcribe a short mixed-character message and send a short message at a declared speed with error rate recorded.
records.maintenance_note: Set review timing from delayed performance and real-world use; annual-only practice is not assumed sufficient.
records.safety_notes: Treat as a communication skill, not a substitute for modern emergency communications or local regulations.

records.name: Rubik’s Cube 3×3 (beginner solve)
records.target_performance: Solve a standard 3×3 cube using a documented beginner method, understanding move notation and maintaining cube state.
records.assessment: Solve from a random legal scramble without a guide, recording completion and any algorithm prompts; repeat on separate days.
records.maintenance_note: Set review timing from delayed performance and real-world use; annual-only practice is not assumed sufficient.
records.safety_notes: Use ordinary cube practice; speed-solving is a separate advanced pathway.

records.name: Locksport Fundamentals (owned transparent practice lock only)
records.target_performance: Understand lock components and lawful locksport ethics using a transparent educational practice lock owned by the learner.
records.assessment: Identify the named components on the transparent training model and explain consent, ownership and legal boundaries. Any hands-on progression is restricted to the dedicated practice model.
records.maintenance_note: Set review timing from delayed performance and real-world use; annual-only practice is not assumed sufficient.
records.safety_notes: Never apply to real doors, property, unknown locks or access controls; no covert entry, bypassing security or evasion. Confirm local law and guardian approval.

records.name: French Drop (basic coin-vanish sleight)
records.target_performance: Perform a simple coin-vanish illusion with controlled hand positioning, natural timing and an honest performance context.
records.assessment: Perform for a consenting observer who can describe the effect; repeat cleanly from multiple viewing angles without unsafe props.
records.maintenance_note: Set review timing from delayed performance and real-world use; annual-only practice is not assumed sufficient.
records.safety_notes: Use as consensual entertainment; do not use sleight of hand to steal, cheat or manipulate transactions.

records.name: One-Handed Card Shuffle (basic packet control)
records.target_performance: Perform a controlled one-handed shuffle with a standard deck, maintaining packet control and avoiding excessive finger strain.
records.assessment: Complete 10 controlled shuffles with no dropped cards and consistent packet recombination.
records.maintenance_note: Set review timing from delayed performance and real-world use; annual-only practice is not assumed sufficient.
records.safety_notes: Stop if fingers or wrist hurt; adapt deck size and hand position.

records.name: Faro Shuffle (introductory card interweave)
records.target_performance: Understand the in-faro/out-faro distinction and perform a controlled interweave with a suitable deck under low pressure.
records.assessment: Demonstrate a defined number of clean interweaves and identify errors; exactness and repeatability matter more than speed.
records.maintenance_note: Set review timing from delayed performance and real-world use; annual-only practice is not assumed sufficient.
records.safety_notes: Advanced dexterity pathway; avoid forcing cards or straining hands.

records.name: Safe Lighter Handling (non-flourish replacement for Zippo trick)
records.target_performance: Understand lighter components, safe storage and basic supervised operation without flame tricks or spinning a lit lighter.
records.assessment: Explain fire and burn hazards, demonstrate safe handling only with guardian permission and appropriate supervision, and store it safely.
records.acquisition_estimate: Brief safety orientation; recurring safe habits
records.maintenance_note: Set review timing from delayed performance and real-world use; annual-only practice is not assumed sufficient.
records.safety_notes: No flame tricks, juggling, ignition stunts or unsupervised use. This deliberately replaces the previously discussed Zippo trick.

records.name: Stadium Whistle (finger-assisted loud whistle)
records.target_performance: Produce a clear, controlled whistle suitable for signalling in an appropriate setting, using hygienic technique and avoiding excessive strain.
records.assessment: Produce repeatable short signals at a controlled volume and stop promptly if discomfort occurs.
records.acquisition_estimate: Several short sessions; individual variation is high
records.maintenance_note: Set review timing from delayed performance and real-world use; annual-only practice is not assumed sufficient.
records.safety_notes: Wash hands first; do not place dirty fingers in mouth; avoid prolonged maximal-volume practice near others or in enclosed spaces.

records.name: Signature Dish (repeatable personal recipe)
records.target_performance: Prepare one chosen dish consistently by following a recipe, measuring ingredients, managing timing and applying food hygiene.
records.assessment: Prepare the dish safely on three separate occasions with consistent doneness, taste and timing, documenting adjustments.
records.maintenance_note: Set review timing from delayed performance and real-world use; annual-only practice is not assumed sufficient.
records.safety_notes: Age-appropriate kitchen supervision; knife, heat, allergen and food-storage safety.

records.name: Advanced Everyday Tie Knots (non-life-safety set)
records.target_performance: Tie and identify a selected set of decorative and everyday utility knots, explain their intended uses and limitations.
records.assessment: Tie each selected knot from memory, inspect structure and explain where it must not be used.
records.maintenance_note: Set review timing from delayed performance and real-world use; annual-only practice is not assumed sufficient.
records.safety_notes: Not climbing, rescue, rigging, restraint or life-safety competence; those require separate qualified training.

records.name: Prepare a kitchen station using mise en place
records.target_performance: Before a simple supervised recipe, identify required ingredients and tools, check quantities, prepare ingredients safely, arrange the work area in task order and keep raw/ready-to-eat items separated.
records.assessment: Using a simple no-heat recipe or a supervised age-appropriate recipe, produce an ingredient-and-tool checklist, prepare the station, identify one missing item or sequencing risk, and restore the workspace safely.
records.maintenance_note: Use short practice opportunities when preparing food; schedule a delayed reconstruction of the station plan and update from observed omissions or unsafe sequencing.
records.safety_notes: Use age-appropriate no-heat or supervised preparation. A trusted adult handles heat, sharp knives and hazardous equipment. Check allergies, hand hygiene, clean surfaces and raw-food separation; do not taste unsafe or unidentified ingredients.
